[Merfolk Lore](/Feats.aspx?ID=5343) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Merfolk" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=761" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 36

</column>

---

You paid close attention to your lessons in school. You gain the trained proficiency rank in [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35) and [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47). If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

 You also gain the [Additional Lore](/Feats.aspx?ID=5114) feat for Merfolk [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8).
name: Merfolk Lore
